hypothesis_ledger.hypothesis: Mesh-aware local CCNN beats the unscaled stencil at N>16
hypothesis_ledger.next_action: If supported, isolate finite-volume versus spectral discretization; otherwise diagnose operator learning and grid scaling.

hypothesis_ledger.hypothesis: Finite-volume CCNN improves on the best resolution-neutral or spectral control at N=128
hypothesis_ledger.next_action: If contradicted, do not claim spatial advantage; improve the operator only after isolating what the control models better.

hypothesis_ledger.hypothesis: Diffusion-based CCNN advantage is universal across local and nonlocal dynamics
hypothesis_ledger.next_action: If contradicted, narrow the claim; investigate learned nonlocal flux or adaptive operator selection, not arbitrary added depth.

hypothesis_ledger.hypothesis: Unchanged scaled CCNN is stable and avoids severe error growth with resolution
hypothesis_ledger.next_action: If contradicted, check training-grid bias, discrete operator eigenvalues, and solver stiffness.

hypothesis_ledger.hypothesis: CCNN gains justify additional compute compared with pointwise ODE
hypothesis_ledger.evidence: CCNN=0.01211 ms/sample; pointwise ODE=0.1648 ms/sample; CCNN/local MSE=0.002546; pointwise/local MSE=0.04058
hypothesis_ledger.next_action: No speed claim until the semigroup and RK4 are compared under matched solver accuracy and wall-clock budget.
